# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(stage4 CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(OpenFHE REQUIRED)
# Use OpenFHE's own flags for ABI consistency (MATHBACKEND, OpenMP), but drop
# -Werror so our validation code isn't blocked by upstream-header warnings.
string(REPLACE "-Werror" "" _NB_CXX_FLAGS "${OpenFHE_CXX_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${_NB_CXX_FLAGS}")

set(_NB_INCLUDES
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/core
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/pke
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/binfhe)
if(EXISTS "${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/third-party/include")
    list(APPEND _NB_INCLUDES ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/third-party/include)
endif()

# OpenFHE was built with OpenMP; make libomp discoverable at link time
# (Homebrew keeps it keg-only, not on the default linker path).
find_library(NB_OMP omp HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib /usr/local/opt/libomp/lib)
if(NB_OMP)
    get_filename_component(_NB_OMP_DIR "${NB_OMP}" DIRECTORY)
    link_directories(${_NB_OMP_DIR})
endif()

foreach(exe smoke stage4_validate)
    add_executable(${exe} ${exe}.cpp)
    target_include_directories(${exe} PRIVATE ${_NB_INCLUDES})
    target_link_libraries(${exe} PRIVATE ${OpenFHE_SHARED_LIBRARIES})
endforeach()
